title: What is liquidity in trading?
description:
Buy-side liquidity, liquidity grab and reversal.

#daytrading #liquidity #smc #ict
spoken_transcript:
Kind: captions
Language: en
Every time you place your stop loss
above a high, you're placing it where
thousands of other traders place theirs,
too.
See these equal highs? That's not
liquidity. Liquidity is all the stop
losses above the high. What does price
do? Price pushes up, takes all those
stops, grabs the liquidity, and then
reverses. The high wasn't the target.
Liquidity was the target.
